assumptions: n is finite and at least one
rho is an n-qubit density operator
pure stabilizer states use the standard n-qubit Clifford-orbit/common-eigenspace convention
mixing is classical convex mixing, not coherent superposition
conclusion: STAB_n is the convex hull of pure n-qubit stabilizer states; rho is a nonstabilizer resource exactly when rho is outside STAB_n.
semantic_guards: pure stabilizer state is not synonymous with a mixed free stabilizer state
stabilizerness membership is not itself a unique scalar monotone
do not call this object a Clifford polytope; that phrase is commonly used for a different channel/gate polytope

formalization.not_covered: The source's full stabilizer-protocol syntax, ancilla/measurement/discard/conditioning semantics, and selective on-average monotonicity are scoped out.

blocking_reason: The n-qubit atom and convex-hull equivalence is kernel-checked, but the imported Gottesman contract remains scientifically unaccepted and independent human source/physical-semantic review plus the separate operation-class alignment remain open.
